headline: Dhaka's bus routes and terminals set for major overhaul
summary: Authorities are working to organize bus owners into route-based companies to streamline city transport.
details: The Dhaka city transport system is undergoing a major overhaul of its bus routes and terminals to improve efficiency and reduce congestion.
Efforts are currently underway to organize individual bus owners into route-based companies, moving away from the fragmented ownership model.
This restructuring is 목표 (goal) aimed at streamlining operations, ensuring better scheduling, and improving the overall commuter experience in the capital.
The move is expected to reduce the chaotic nature of current bus operations and bring more professional management to the city's public transport.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman to [[visit China for defence, politics and investment]]
headline: PM Tarique Rahman to visit China for defence, politics and investment
summary: The visit will focus on strengthening ties, reviving the long-stalled Chinese Economic and Industrial Zone, and exploring new investment opportunities.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is scheduled to visit China later this month, focusing on key areas including defence, politics, and investment, according to BIDA Executive Chairman Chowdhury Ashik Mahmud Bin Harun.

A major highlight of the trip is the revival of the Chinese Economic and Industrial Zone (CEIZ), a project that had been stalled for over a decade. The government has already approved a Tk 41.89 billion project to establish the zone with Chinese financing.

China has remained Bangladesh's largest source of investment over the past five years, and the government aims to use the first two years of its term to attract more foreign investment and infrastructure projects.

Beyond investment, the visit will address regional politics and diplomatic ties. China has also expressed interest in the Mongla Port and a second economic zone in that region, alongside the proposed zone in Chattogram's Anwara.

This visit follows a trend of strengthening ties with China after the fall of the previous administration in July 2024, with leaders from various parties including the BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami having already visited Beijing.
The Prime Minister's first official foreign trip is expected to be to Malaysia, with the China visit being viewed as more significant for regional trade and politics.
caption:

Beyond investment, the visit will address regional politics and diplomatic ties. China has also expressed interest in the Mongla Port and a second economic zone in that region, alongside the proposed zone in Chattogram's Anwara.
